verdict.rationale: Cline documents signing in once to its Cline provider and choosing models without managing separate vendor API keys. Free access, however, is described only as periodic free-model promotions with a limited usage quota, and the standard path involves adding paid credits. missing for 10: a standing documented free tier tied to the personal account, explicit evidence that the free promotions are reachable through sign-in alone, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Instead of managing separate API keys across multiple vendors, you sign in once, add Cline credits, and select from available models directly in Cline.
Cline periodically offers free model promotions that let you try select models at no cost, up to a limited usage quota.
